caption:
Abinash built Scorched: sign in with Google and it turns up to 200 of your liked YouTube videos into a roast report with a 0 to 100 brainrot score. Code counts four patterns, Gemini writes the jokes, and nothing is saved after the report.

Try it: https://scorched-bice.vercel.app/
Code: https://github.com/abinash2553J/scorched

Send this to the friend whose likes are mostly Shorts. They know who they are.
